data.long_meaning: The name Dalbir is derived from Sanskrit. It is a compound of two words: Dal and Bir. Dal means servant or devoted, and Bir means dharma or righteousness. data.spiritual_meaning: Dedicated to the path of righteousness

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dalbir total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
